answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 1259 Country: India Title: My problem is that when i sit on computer i used to see bad things on internet; nude pictures etc. But in the day i make dauba, i used to do same very often. What should I do? Question: My problem is that when i sit on computer i used to see bad things on internet; nude pictures etc. But in the day i make dauba, i used to do same very often. What should I do? Answer ID: 1259 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1145/861=H) Make it compulsory upon you that if I commit the sin you must give salary of three days in charity to the poor and pray twelve rakats of nafl salah . And, try to act upon it with determination though it is hard on you. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
